milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the oak_wood cross-shaped structure centered at spawn-relative (3, 1, 3) and face it, confirming visual identification. max_distance reduced from 16 to 5 per ValidatorAgent feedback — the structure is ~4.2 blocks from spawn, so max_distance=5 ensures the player must actively orient toward it rather than trivially satisfying the check. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the oak_wood blocks.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted dark_oak_pressure_plate ends up in the player's inventory and is not present at episode start. The recipe requires 2 dark_oak_planks in a horizontal row, which fits in the 2x2 player inventory crafting grid (no crafting table strictly required, though one is provided at spawn-relative (5,0,3) for convenience). Player starts with 4 dark_oak_planks — double the minimum needed.
